Turn on Always watching, allow the notification, allow Display over other apps, and skip battery optimization.

Then copy as usual. Clippy stays in the background and saves text and images. You can still tap Save clipboard now or share into Clippy.

Everything stays on this phone until you delete it.

Clippy stays on in the background. Allow Display over other apps so it can catch copies. Android still makes the app peek on screen for a moment when you copy — that is an OS rule, not Clippy quitting.
Clipboard is empty or blocked. Open Clippy first, then copy again.
Always on. Copies are saved to history.
Display over other apps is on
